results.name: controls-minimum
results.semantics:
- region "Game menus":
  - heading "CONTROL BINDINGS" [level=1]
  - status: Select an action to rebind. Duplicate assignments swap. Delete resets all; Escape goes back.
  - button "Keyboard" [pressed]
  - button "Controller"
  - 'button "MOVE UP: W"'
  - 'button "MOVE DOWN: S"'
  - 'button "MOVE LEFT: A"'
  - 'button "MOVE RIGHT: D"'
  - 'button "ROLL / EVADE: SPACE"'
  - 'button "INTERACT: E"'
  - 'button "ULTIMATE: R"'
  - 'button "USE KIT: Q"'
  - 'button "FIRE MODE: T"'
  - 'button "PAUSE: ESC"'
  - button "Reset all bindings"
  - button "Back"
